title: School Life Paragraph
titleMy: ကျောင်းဘဝ စာပိုဒ်
description: Type about school life. Practice capital letters at sentence starts.

exercises.instruction: Our school has many big and bright classrooms. The teachers are kind and patient. We study English, Math, and Science every day. I enjoy learning new things with my classmates.
